title: MobileSettingsAssignment - Data API
description: Represents the assignment of a particular field service mobile settings configuration to a user profile. This object is available in API version 41.0 and later.

FieldServiceMobileSettingsId.description: The ID of a set of field service mobile settings.

ProfileId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ProfileId.description: The ID of the profile to associate with the set of field service mobile settings.
